description: Return a Coinbase URL for selling ETH or USDC from wallet_address for fiat paid to the user's bank or Coinbase balance, in two calls like create_coinbase_onramp_link. Needs a Coinbase account. After the user presses Cash out, get_coinbase_offramp_transaction gives the deposit address and amount to send within 30 minutes. Live or sandbox per this server's configuration: the result's environment says which, and real_payment is true only for live checkouts.

asset.description: Crypto to sell: ETH or USDC

crypto_amount.description: Amount of the asset to sell in whole units, e.g. 0.05 or 100, not base units or wei. Omit to let the user choose on Coinbase

network.description: Network the crypto is sent from; default base

wallet_address.description: EVM address that holds the crypto being sold and sends it to Coinbase

name: create_coinbase_offramp_link
title: Create a Coinbase Offramp (sell) link
